entries.63bc052f69e27b5d: The company positions itself as a mid-sized shipyard whose technological capabilities are highly evaluated both in Japan and overseas, and it has ship types such as small and medium-sized ferries and RORO ships in which it has extensive construction experience. Making use of its 2-plant structure in Setoda and Innoshima, it is working to improve productivity through continuous construction of vessels of the same type. Under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's energy-saving rating system for coastal vessels, 23 vessels it has built have received the highest rating.

entries.aa8b00fc0a1fa150: In the New Shipbuilding Business, the company states that it will promote a product mix of oceangoing vessels such as general cargo ships and car carriers and coastal vessels such as ferries and RORO ships, and build a diverse range of ship types from Panamax-size medium-sized vessels to small ferries. It also sets out strengthening cost competitiveness through enhancement of the integrated order-to-delivery system (sales, design, procurement, and operations) and thorough risk management, and expansion of business scale and cost reduction through strategic capital investment in its 2 plants. In the Ship Repair Business, it sets out improving customer satisfaction through speedy and flexible responses and providing high-quality repairs using technology and know-how. For the fiscal year ending March 2027, it states that it will work to improve productivity and other measures, with a view to achieving the consolidated forecast of net sales of ¥46 billion.
